en: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.”

zh: 以東人多益來告訴掃羅說：「大衛到了亞希米勒家。」那時，大衛作這訓誨詩，交與伶長。

p.src: 1  Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

en: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
u.src: 1  Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

p.src: 2  Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

en: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
u.src: 2  Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

p.src: 3  You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

en: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
u.src: 3  You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

p.src: 4  You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

en: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
u.src: 4  You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

p.src: 5  God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

en: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
u.src: 5  God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

p.src: 6  The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

en: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
u.src: 6  The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

p.src: 7  “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

en: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
u.src: 7  “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

p.src: 8  But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

en: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
u.src: 8  But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

p.src: 9  I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

en: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
u.src: 9  I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
